plainLanguage: Section 97 — False certificates by public officers. Ufafanuzi huu unalenga statutory elements za provision hii bila kubadilisha official text.
meaning: The provision concerns a legally authorised/required certificate that the maker knows is false in a material particular and which can prejudicially affect rights.
keyPoints: Apply the exact statutory elements and any express exceptions.
Official status, authority, knowledge, purpose or prejudice must be proved where the section requires it.
Do not infer liability from the section title alone.

history.summary: Section 97 forms part of Chapter X — Abuse of Office — in The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official R.E. 2022 text audited before explanation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each statutory element should be established independently from admissible evidence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Legal authority, exceptions and prosecution prerequisites are substantive parts of the analysis where the section states them.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inathibitisha kila statutory requirement ya section 97?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
